metadata.title: Parcel-level usable area for on-site solar and wind at U.S. manufacturing parcels: NLCD and reV benchmark
metadata.description:
Parcel-level estimates of usable land area for ground-mount solar PV and land-based wind at 305,123 manufacturing parcels in the contiguous United States. These parcels host 338,904 facilities in M-FIND v1.1. The dataset compares the NLCD land-cover-proportion method with the NLR reV composite exclusion method: Open, Reference and Limited scenarios, with five wind turbine configurations. It also includes NLCD 2021 class areas, binary wind exclusion flags, a forest-availability sensitivity for solar and reV QA flags.

Parcel polygons are licensed from LightBox and are not redistributed. Rows are keyed to public M-FIND v1.1 obs_id values. Results for the parcel-fabric-based reV Parcel Joined layer are given as size-bin and state aggregates only.

This dataset accompanies Rose and Ramos, "Sizing up on-site industrial energy potential: a parcel-level comparison of usable-area methods" (Applied Energy, under review). See README.md and CODEBOOK.txt.
